title: Supreme Court Temporarily Restores Telehealth Access to Mifepristone
detail: The US Supreme Court restores telehealth access to the abortion pill mifepristone for at least one week, pausing lower-court restrictions while legal challenges continue. The emergency order blocks enforcement of a federal appeals court ruling that had curtailed access to the medication.

media.caption: Supreme Court pauses lower-court restrictions on mifepristone telehealth access
